_meta.definition: The process of managing and maintaining customer profiles, including personal information, account details, and purchasing history.

customers._description: Captures customer details including personal information, contact data, and financial information for managing online sales at DellStore2.

columns.name: customerid
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in customers

columns.name: firstname
columns.description: Stores customer names, represented as alphanumeric strings of up to 10 characters.

columns.name: lastname
columns.description: Stores customer surnames up to 10 characters long.

columns.name: address1
columns.description: Stores detailed street addresses of customers at Dell Way.

columns.name: address2
columns.description: Stores additional customer address information (if provided).

columns.name: city
columns.description: Stores city names up to 10 characters long, possibly abbreviated.

columns.name: state
columns.description: Stores two-letter abbreviations for U.S. states of customers.

columns.name: zip
columns.description: Stores 5-digit postal codes for customers.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Stores customer countries as 50 character VARCHARs, with all provided examples being American (USA).

columns.name: region
columns.description: Stores customer region IDs, all set to 1 in these samples.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Stores unique email addresses of Dell customers.

columns.name: phone
columns.description: Stores customer phone numbers as 10-digit integers.

columns.name: creditcardtype
columns.description: Stores customer credit card type identifiers (1: Visa, 4: Mastercard, 5: Amex, 3: Discover)

columns.name: creditcard
columns.description: Stores 15-digit customer credit card numbers.

columns.name: creditcardexpiration
columns.description: Stores credit card expiration dates in YYYY/MM format.

columns.name: username
columns.description: Stores usernames up to 10 characters for customer accounts.

columns.name: "password"
columns.description: Stores encrypted customer passwords of maximum 10 characters.

columns.name: age
columns.description: Stores customer ages as integers, ranging from 21 to 80 years.

columns.name: income
columns.description: Stores customer's annual income as integer values, typically in thousands of dollars.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Stores customer gender data as either 'M' for male or 'F' for female (up to 10 characters).
